narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build is green now.** The bump broke two things, both real.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Reads `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` | Accept both |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, strict check threw | `undefined` means off |

The 8 warnings stay. They are `DEP0142` and friends from the new deps. The files they name, like `src/legacy/adapter.js`, are not in this repo.

Next: nothing, unless you want those deprecated calls chased down.
